review_findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the remaining JVM expectations for Romanian successors**

When the hosted JVM aggregate runs, two existing tests still assert the superseded Romanian behavior. `ImportSelectionTitleTest.catalanAndRomanianAnimationWarningsKeepMixedCountsAndRealImportDecisions` asserts `"at least 2"` at line 221 and reads the historical animation-message fixture directly, so both its count and subsequent message expectations conflict with these resources. Separately, `ImageDisplayLocaleTest.englishFallbackStillUsesSelectedLocaleNumbers` (lines 72–79) still expects English `Pixel count` text for Romanian, although this patch adds `Număr de pixeli`. The workflow's `:Paintroid:test${BUILD_VARIANT^}UnitTest` aggregate includes these tests, so the new eight tests do not prevent these existing runtime assertion failures. Apply the bounded successor expectations to these consumers too, preserving the historical fixtures and retaining an actually untranslated locale for the English-fallback check.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
